how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:ahn-qiraj-war-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8492:obj:0: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8492:details:0: Hey there, ⟦1⟧, you look fit enough to contribute to the war effort! We need all of the help that we can get here to put together the materiel needed for the Ahn'Qiraj War and it's your lucky day.
rows.quest:8492:details:1: BI'm collecting copper bars in stacks of twenty. It's for a worthy cause, what do you say? Do you think you could help out the ⟦E2⟧?
rows.quest:8492:completion:0: You did it, lad! We'll get those copper bars onto the pile and put them to good use making the war materiel right away. It's the efforts of people like you that make me proud to serve the ⟦E2⟧. Good work, soldier!
rows.quest:8492:completion:1: BAnd if you should happen to come across more copper bars, make sure that they find their way to me.
rows.quest:8494:obj:0: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8494:details:0: Well hello there, ⟦2⟧ Fancypants, aren't you a sight for sore eyes. In case you hadn't heard while you were out there "adventuring", the ⟦E2⟧ has been gearing up for a war in Ahn'Qiraj and is in need of iron bars... a whole mess of 'em. Bring them to me in stacks of twenty. We can count on you, right, ⟦3⟧?
rows.quest:8494:completion:0: Well, well, if it isn't ⟦4⟧. And you pulled through. I guess now I'll have to keep my eye on you. It hurts me to say this, but thanks for your efforts. The ⟦E2⟧ won't forget, and neither will I. Now get out there and bust your hump on whatever else needs collecting.
rows.quest:8499:obj:0: Bring 20 Thorium Bars to Dame Twinbraid at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8499:details:0: It is very kind of you to inquire about the needs that the ⟦E2⟧ has. In addition to all of the other collection efforts underway, we are in need of a great quantity of thorium bars, which is the task that I am in charge of. The thorium will be used in the creation of many different things for the war, foremost of which is the construction of a battalion of steam tanks to be airlifted into ⟦E3⟧ as soon as they are completed. Can you aid us in this endeavor, ⟦5⟧?
rows.quest:8499:completion:0: So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...
rows.quest:8503:obj:0: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8503:details:0: So, ⟦6⟧, did I already tell you about all of the fabulous uses stranglekelp has? I did? Oh well... in any case we need a lot of it, and when I say a lot, I mean A LOT! Do you think that you could help us out? I know that it means going without all of those wonderful things that you can make with it, but it's for a good cause!
rows.quest:8503:completion:0: Hooray! That's another twenty down. You're the best. I suppose that I should get these all packed away before they wither. So much stranglekelp, so little time!
rows.quest:8505:obj:0: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Master Nightsong at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8505:details:0: ⟦8⟧, the purple lotus is a flower with a plentitude of uses. I am here at the request of the ⟦E2⟧ as an authority on those applications, to preserve the herbs collected and to ensure that their war effort acquires enough purple lotus to sustain whatever function they plan for it.
rows.quest:8505:details:1: BI would like for you to travel out into the world and return to me with some of these flowers. Is that something that you can do?
rows.quest:8505:completion:0: Your contribution is greatly appreciated, ⟦9⟧. It is only through the combined efforts of all that we shall be able to repel the ruthless advance of the silithid and whatever force is driving them forth. Even the ⟦E4⟧ is amassing their own collection of purple lotus. Should you come across more, please return to me here.
rows.quest:8509:obj:0: Bring 20 ⟦E5⟧' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8509:details:0: I'll keep it simple and to the point, ⟦10⟧. The ⟦E2⟧ needs to collect a large quantity of ⟦E5⟧' Tears for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Don't ask me what for; I'm just following orders. But I'd like you to gather up as many of the herbs as you can and bring them back to me here. Are you willing to do that?
rows.quest:8509:completion:0: Good work, ⟦11⟧. I must say that I'm pleasantly surprised. You would not believe the number of people that have come by, offering to help, but never returning. Let me just get those into a crate and tallied with your name on it, and then we can talk again about whether I need anymore of those plants.
rows.quest:8511:obj:0: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8511:details:0: We Stoneflayers have a long history of being skinners, ⟦12⟧. That's why the ⟦E2⟧ has asked my family to help out with the collection of ⟦E6⟧ for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm here to see to it that the leather is tanned correctly for whatever they want to put it to use for. But we need your help.
rows.quest:8511:details:1: BSince I have to be here doing that, I need you to go out and collect the skins, returning them to me here. What do you say, ⟦13⟧, will you give it a go?
rows.quest:8511:completion:0: I dare say the ⟦E2⟧ is going to be very happy with your skins here, ⟦14⟧. I'll make sure that not a one goes to waste. Thank you, and make sure that you check back in with me once I've counted them up to see if we need more.
rows.quest:8513:obj:0: Bring 10 Medium Leather to Private Porter at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8513:details:0: Yes ⟦15⟧, I have been charged with collecting and tracking all of the medium leather gathered for the war effort. If you have the wherewithal to gather medium leather, from whatever source, then please bring them to me here. I sure would appreciate a hand with this if you can spare the time.
rows.quest:8513:completion:0: Wow! Seems like you were just here volunteering to help. Thank you very much for the donation. I'll just get those all packed up and counted. You sure do know how to brighten a fella's day.
rows.quest:8515:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E7⟧ to Marta Finespindle at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8515:details:0: Oh boy, this is going to be great! ⟦16⟧, the Ahn'Qiraj war effort is in full swing, and I've been put in charge of keeping track of all of the thick leather that comes in. We'll make tons of things with it, but first we need to get a ton of it. And I mean that literally! That's where you come in.
rows.quest:8515:details:1: BSo, do you think you can go out there and bring me back a nice, fat stack of thick leather? Do yah, do yah?!
rows.quest:8515:completion:0: Oh, I knew you could do it, ⟦17⟧, I just knew it! I'll get these into the right hands as soon as I can. Now, let's see here. Hmm, looks like our tally is coming along rather nicely. You should check back with me in just a moment once I'm done counting to see if we need more. Cuz if we do, you're the one I want out there gathering it up for me!
rows.quest:8517:obj:0: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8517:details:0: The war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to be long and bloody. It is a very wise thing that the ⟦E2⟧ is doing by enlisting the aid of you, and those like you, to build up the materiel necessary before plunging headlong into conflict.
rows.quest:8517:details:1: BI have been asked to head up the collection of ⟦E8⟧ bandages for the war, and I am hoping that you are going to assist me in amassing as many as we need. It is no light matter, but at least the ⟦E8⟧ bandages are the least difficult to create. Are you with us, ⟦18⟧?
rows.quest:8517:completion:0: Many are the soldiers that will benefit from your contribution here today, ⟦19⟧. I shall see to it personally that the ⟦E2⟧ is made aware of your efforts. Allow me a moment to store these bandages properly and update my count, and then you should check back with me to see if I am in need of more.
rows.quest:8517:completion:1: BMay the Light of ⟦E9⟧ shine upon you, ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:8520:obj:0: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8520:details:0: With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough ⟦E10⟧ bandages.
rows.quest:8520:details:1: BDo you think you can help me out, ⟦21⟧?
rows.quest:8520:completion:0: This Nightscape equipment you have supplied fills the order perfectly, ⟦22⟧. I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.
rows.quest:8520:completion:1: BYou have definitely earned this pattern. I give it to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.
rows.quest:8522:obj:0: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8522:details:0: Argue the merits of the war if you will, ⟦23⟧, but it has already been set in motion. Look around you at your family and friends, and then ask yourself what it is that you can do to see to it that if they are involved, they will have every advantage to survive the conflagration.
rows.quest:8522:details:1: BTo that end, I am collecting runecloth bandages here from whatever source. Would you like to make a donation?
rows.quest:8522:completion:0: You are to be commended, ⟦24⟧, for your perseverance in this task. I shall put these bandages away, and then I should like to talk to you again about the possibility of your collecting even more runecloth bandages.
rows.quest:8524:obj:0: Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8524:details:0: Hey there, friend! If I were to say to you, 'Don't you think that soldiers should have food to eat like anyone else?', you would of course reply, 'yes'. I agree with you 110%! I'm glad we're in accord. All I need for you to do is to head out there, fish up a whole bunch of raw rainbow fin albacore, and then cook it all up and bring it back to me right here. Mmm, mmm, I can taste it already.
rows.quest:8524:completion:0: Two for the ⟦E2⟧, one for me, two for the ⟦E2⟧, one for me. Hey there, fishmonger, excellent work. I can see that you're going to be a real credit to the club. Looks to me like we probably need more of that albacore though. Why don't you head on out and rustle up a mite more. I can hear my stomach rumbling already.
rows.quest:8526:obj:0: Bring 20 Roast ⟦E11⟧ to ⟦E12⟧ Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8526:details:0: Oh, how's it going, ⟦25⟧? I see that you're interested in maybe gathering up food for the coming war at Ahn'Qiraj? Somehow my dad thought that it would be a good learning experience for me if I were to volunteer to help out here. Big mistake. I don't even like to eat meat.
rows.quest:8526:details:1: BAnyway, if you feel like it, you could bring me back a lot of roast raptor. Apparently that's what all of the soldiers are going to want.
rows.quest:8526:completion:0: Gee, that's swell. Thanks for bringing me all of this burnt animal flesh, ⟦26⟧. I'll just put it onto the pile over there. I'm sure that someone will take care of it. I suppose if you have some time on your hands that you might want to bring me more?
rows.quest:8528:obj:0: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8528:details:0: It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young ⟦27⟧. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.
rows.quest:8528:details:1: BAccordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
rows.quest:8528:completion:0: Thank you for this gift, ⟦28⟧, and in such a timely manner as well. Our soldiers will surely not lack for something to eat. Just let me get these fish stored away properly and then you and I can discuss a second haul if you're willing.
rows.quest:8532:obj:0: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8532:details:0: So glad that you've decided to help out here. Not everyone would, so I need to make sure you understand what it is that I need. Copper bars, not copper ore. We don't have the time or people to do all of the smelting ourselves, so if you would be so kind as to take care of that, your efforts will be duly noted. Is that something that you can handle, ⟦29⟧?
rows.quest:8532:completion:0: These bars will do, and thanks for not shining them. No sense in making them pretty when they're going to be mangled for whatever materiel needs to be built for the war. I'll take care of putting them on the stacks, and I'll make sure that they are put to proper use. Speak to me again if you're interested in bringing in another twenty.
rows.quest:8542:obj:0: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8542:details:0: Lok'tar, ⟦30⟧, I'm sure you already know that we're going to war at Ahn'Qiraj with the insects. But first the Warchief has decided that we're going to do something called 'prepare'. Though I'd rather be sharpening weapons and hammering armor into shape, I'm proud to have been chosen to be in charge of tin bar collection here. But I cannot do that without your help.
rows.quest:8542:details:1: BSo I need you to go out and make tin bars and bring them back to me here. I think I'm going to need more than I can count.⟦31⟧
rows.quest:8542:completion:0: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
rows.quest:8545:obj:0: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8545:details:0: ⟦32⟧, the war it is comin' and the only thing we can do is prepare for it. That be where you and I can help each other, mon. Ya see, they put me in charge of collectin' all the mithril bars we be needin' ta build for all the things we gonna need. An I still be needin' more!
rows.quest:8545:details:1: BSo, I be hopin' that you can get out there an mine us up some mithril, then smelt it into bars. Sound like something you can do for us?
rows.quest:8545:completion:0: This be a good start for you an me, ⟦33⟧. That be another twenty mithril bars that I can be puttin' on the stacks an checkin' off of the list. It all gonna be put to good use makin' the war materiel.
rows.quest:8545:completion:1: BBe makin' sure that you check back in with me 'cuz you know it be lookin' like we gonna need even more of those mithril bars.
rows.quest:8549:obj:0: Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8549:details:0: It is said that every generation must face a defining trial. I fear the Ahn'Qiraj War will be the crucible in which our mettle is tested. So we prepare, and in so doing find what we are made of.
rows.quest:8549:details:1: BI have volunteered to help the ⟦E4⟧ by gathering as much peacebloom as possible, so that it can be made into potions for the war. I hope that you are here to lend me your aid. If so, then I need you to bring back to me a good quantity of the herb. Will you assist me, ⟦34⟧?
rows.quest:8549:completion:0: This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, ⟦35⟧.
rows.quest:8580:obj:0: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8580:details:0: Hey, ⟦36⟧. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the ⟦E4⟧ thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the ⟦E2⟧ as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!
rows.quest:8580:details:1: BPele'keiki know this though... he know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?
rows.quest:8580:completion:0: Cross your fingers, friend! Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!
rows.quest:8582:obj:0: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8582:details:0: The purple lotus, ⟦37⟧, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.
rows.quest:8582:details:1: BThat's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. Is this something that you are willing to do for us?
rows.quest:8582:completion:0: A commendable effort, ⟦38⟧. I will measure these specimens for their appropriate usage and note your contribution. The purple lotus will then need to be properly stored until I am ready for them. As for you, if you are still available I should imagine that I'll still need more purple lotus. Please check back with me in a moment.
rows.quest:8588:obj:0: Bring 10 Heavy Leather to Skinner Jamani at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8588:details:0: Since we're preparing for war, it might be best if we get all of the goods we need first, don't you think, mon? One of the staples of the war materiel that we're producing is heavy leather. We'll use it for just about everything, from reinforcement to armor, and good old plain tarps too.
rows.quest:8588:details:1: BBut first we need to get our hands on more of it. That's your job, ⟦39⟧. Sharpen your knife and bring me back a bundle. Then we'll talk further.
rows.quest:8588:completion:0: Simply amazing... look at the purity of these samples. Hmm, I wonder what it could mean. They seem to be elemental in nature, but... something more. They remind me of... of the Old Gods. We've found traces of them throughout ⟦E14⟧, and now I wonder if these creatures aren't related to them somehow.
rows.quest:8588:completion:1: BWe shall have to test further.
rows.quest:8590:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E7⟧ to Sergeant Umala at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8590:details:0: I'm glad that you decided to speak to me about this, ⟦40⟧. It looks like the ⟦E4⟧'s preparations for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War are in full swing. But you and I still need to do our part.
rows.quest:8590:details:1: BI've been asked to collect a great number of thick leather skins for use in all manner of war materiel, and I need you to help me by going out there and gathering them up. There's honor and the gratitude of the ⟦E4⟧ in it for you should you decide to help. Will you?
rows.quest:8590:completion:0: Good work, ⟦41⟧. I'm sure that these thick leather skins will be put to use reinforcing zeppelins and making all manner of armor and weaponry. You have my thanks, and that of the ⟦E4⟧. Come back again if you come across more thick leather in your travels, and luck be with you.
rows.quest:8600:obj:0: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8600:details:0: I find that the fit of the knife in your palm is more important than the edge on it. Even the dullest blade can be made to cut if pressure is being properly applied through it, wouldn't you agree, ⟦42⟧? But you and I don't have such problems as we maintain the sharpest of edges, yes?
rows.quest:8600:details:1: BWell, no matter, I have a task for you. In service to the ⟦E4⟧, and to do your part for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, I want you to return to me with a number of rugged leather skins. This is something that you will do, no?
rows.quest:8600:completion:0: Very well, it appears you've done a fairly decent job of it, though some of those skins look a bit ragged about the edges. No matter, the task is completed, and you have earned your reward. Should you come across another stack of rugged leather, be sure to bring them to me posthaste.
rows.quest:8604:obj:0: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8604:details:0: Greetings, ⟦43⟧. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the ⟦E4⟧'s efforts at gathering ⟦E15⟧ bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.
rows.quest:8604:details:1: BIf you have the time, I need many ⟦E15⟧ bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
rows.quest:8604:completion:0: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
rows.quest:8607:obj:0: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8607:details:0: I trust that you are speaking to me because you are going to help with the collection I have been entrusted to? Good! By whatever means, and I do mean whatever, I wish for you to gather up a good number of mageweave bandages. Fresh would be nice, but not absolutely necessary. Return them to me here, ⟦44⟧, and I will personally see to it that you are properly rewarded.
rows.quest:8607:completion:0: Surprising, yet acceptable. Perhaps I underestimated your 'abilities', ⟦45⟧. Perhaps. You completed a very simple task, and for doing so you are to be rewarded out of proportion. But don't let it go to your head. If you really want to prove yourself you should get out there and bring me another bundle of mageweave bandages.
rows.quest:8609:obj:0: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Stoneguard Clayhoof at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8609:details:0: It appears inevitable that the ⟦E4⟧ and ⟦E2⟧ are on a collision course for war at Ahn'Qiraj. Surprisingly, it is not a war with each other, but rather with the silithid, and whatever force controls them. Also surprisingly, both sides are doing their part to gather the resources necessary to wage a successful war.
rows.quest:8609:details:1: BI am collecting runecloth bandages to distribute to the soldiers, but I won't be successful without assistance, hopefully yours. Is this something that you can aid me with, ⟦46⟧?⟦47⟧
rows.quest:8611:obj:0: Bring 20 Lean Wolf Steaks to Bloodguard Rawtar at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8611:details:0: I'm not standing here just to get a nice tan, ⟦48⟧. There are war preparations to be made. If we're going to crush those bugs at Ahn'Qiraj then we need to be ready, and that includes food too!
rows.quest:8611:details:1: BThey have me gathering and salting lean wolf steaks here for the upcoming war. But since I need to stay here to take care of all of this, I need you to go out, kill some wolves and then cook up the meat into lean wolf steaks and bring them back to me here. You got all that?
rows.quest:8611:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦49⟧! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! Thank you.
rows.quest:8611:completion:1: BI hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of ⟦E16⟧ is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.
rows.quest:8613:obj:0: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Fisherman Lin'do at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8613:details:0: It be a nice day for fishin', don't'cha think mon? Good thing, cuz I be needin' a lot of fish it lookin' like. The ⟦E4⟧, they askin' me to be in charge of collectin' a ton of the spotted yellowtail for them. They say they needin' it for the war they getting' ready for at Ahn'Qiraj. I say to them I do the best I can. So I be needin' to get some help. You gonna be helpin' me, ⟦51⟧?
rows.quest:8613:completion:0: Oh ya, this be the good stuff. I pack it up real nice so it not go to waste. Thanks be to you for helpin' me out like this. I'm thinkin' you an A-number-one fisherman for all this spotted yellowtail. An if you happen to fish up and cook even more, you bring it to me here; I make sure everyone know you did!
rows.quest:8615:obj:0: Bring 20 Baked Salmon to Chief Sharpclaw at the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8615:details:0: The Ahn'Qiraj war effort is an immense undertaking, ⟦52⟧. All of the materials being gathered here, whether it is metal for weapons, or food to eat, are all as important as the other. For, if you haven't eaten in days you will not have the strength to lift your axe when it matters.
rows.quest:8615:details:1: BThus, we gather what food we can. I am collecting baked salmon, a dish that was chosen both for its sustenance and its ability to keep well. Can you aid me with this task, ⟦53⟧?
rows.quest:8615:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦54⟧! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! Thank you.
rows.quest:8615:completion:1: BI hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of ⟦E16⟧ is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.

rows.quest:8792:completion:0: Throm'ka, ⟦58⟧! Good to see so many of the ⟦E4⟧, such as yourself, ⟦59⟧, coming out to lend your support in laying the groundwork for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War. rows.quest:8792:completion:1: BSo now that you are here, be sure to speak with the various collectors and offer your assistance in gathering those materials that you are suited to.
